name: sharable-link
description: Publish HTML you make in a chat (a report, dashboard, proposal, slide deck or prototype) to a link anyone can open in a browser. Make it public, add a password, or share it only with named people or a company domain. Update, edit or unpublish your pages later, keeping the same link.

interface.longDescription:
Make something in ChatGPT, such as a report, a dashboard, a proposal, a slide deck or a clickable prototype, and publish it to a link you can send to a client or a teammate. It opens in any browser, with nothing to install.

You choose who can open each page: anyone with the link, anyone with the link and a password, or only the people and company domains you name, who sign in with Google or Microsoft to view it.

Change a page later and the link stays the same: replace it, or edit one part of it, like a number or a heading. List the pages you've published, with their view counts, and unpublish any of them.

Pages under 150 KB publish straight from the chat. Larger HTML files, up to 25 MB, go through an upload area where you drop the file.

It publishes HTML pages only, and it can't read a published page back into the chat. Sign in with Google or Microsoft to connect. sharable.link never sees your password.
defaultPrompt: Publish this page as a link I can send to my client
Share this dashboard only with people at my company's domain
Show me the pages I've published and how many views each has

positive.description: Publish a page made in the chat and get its link.
positive.prompt: Make a one-page HTML summary of a fictional company's Q3 results and publish it as a link I can send.
positive.expected_behavior: One share_html call. The reply gives a sharable.link URL, and opening it in a browser shows the summary page.

positive.description: Publish a page that needs a password to open.
positive.prompt: Make a short HTML welcome page for new hires and publish it with the password maple-river-42.
positive.expected_behavior: One share_html call with the password. The reply gives a sharable.link URL; opening it asks for the password, and maple-river-42 opens the page.

positive.description: List the pages the signed-in account has published.
positive.prompt: Which pages have I published, and how many views does each have?
positive.expected_behavior: One list_my_pages call. The reply lists the test account's sample pages with their links and view counts.

positive.description: Change part of a published page and keep its link.
positive.prompt: Publish a short HTML page with the heading 'Draft agenda'. Then change the heading to 'Final agenda' and keep the same link.
positive.expected_behavior: share_html returns a URL, then edit_page replaces the heading. The reply gives the same URL, and the page now shows 'Final agenda'.

positive.prompt: Publish a one-line HTML page titled 'Temporary test', then unpublish it.
positive.expected_behavior: share_html returns a URL, then unshare_page removes the page after the person confirms. The URL no longer opens the page.

negative.description: Unrelated to publishing. The plugin should not act, and no sharable.link tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lviv today?

negative.description: The person asks for HTML and says not to publish it. The plugin should not act: the reply gives the code in the chat and calls no sharable.link tool.
negative.prompt: Write an HTML email signature for me. Don't publish it anywhere, I'll copy the code myself.

negative.description: sharable.link publishes HTML pages and has no calendar. The plugin should not act, and no sharable.link tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my client for Friday at 3pm.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish HTML from ChatGPT to a sharable.link page (public, password or named viewers), replace or edit it with the same link, list your pages with view counts, and unpublish them. Large files up to 25 MB through the upload area.
